text_en: An Oracle. The word of the Lord is against the land of Hadrach and will rest upon Damascus. For to the Lord belongs the capital of Aram, as do all the tribes of Israel;
text_cn: 神谕：上主的话临于哈得辣客地，停在大马士革，因为阿兰的眼珠也像以色列的各支派一样，是属于上主的。

text_en: Hamath also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, though they are very wise.
text_cn: 哈玛特也要属于他的版图，还有极其明智的漆冬。

text_en: Tyre has built itself a rampart, and heaped up silver like dust, and gold like the dirt of the streets.
text_cn: 提洛为自己建筑了碉堡，堆积的银子多如尘土，金子像街市上的泥土。

text_en: But now, the Lord will strip it of its possessions and hurl its wealth into the sea, and it shall be devoured by fire.
text_cn: 看，吾主必要占据她，把她的财富抛入海中；她必为火所吞灭。

text_en: Ashkelon shall see it and be afraid; Gaza too, and shall writhe in anguish; Ekron also, because its hopes are withered. The king shall perish from Gaza; Ashkelon shall be uninhabited;
text_cn: 阿市刻隆见了，必要害怕；迦萨也要极度战栗，厄刻龙也是如此，因为她依赖的，遭受了羞辱。迦萨的君王必要丧亡，阿市刻隆再没有人居住。

text_en: a mongrel people shall settle in Ashdod, and I will make an end of the pride of Philistia.
text_cn: 阿市多得必为杂种所居住。当我这样消除了培肋舍特人的傲慢，

text_en: I will take away its blood from its mouth, and its abominations from between its teeth; it too shall be a remnant for our God; it shall be like a clan in Judah, and Ekron shall be like the Jebusites.
text_cn: 由他的口中除去带血的祭肉，从他的牙齿间除去可憎的祭物之后，他的遗民也必要归属于我们的天主，有如犹大中的一个家族；厄刻龙也必像耶步斯人。

text_en: Then I will encamp at my house as a guard, so that no one shall march to and fro; no oppressor shall again overrun them, for now I have seen with my own eyes.
text_cn: 我要为我的家自作营寨，防御往来的人，不再让残暴者由他们中间经过，因为如今我要亲眼防守。

text_en: Rejoice greatly, O daughter Zion! Shout aloud, O daughter Jerusalem! Lo, your king comes to you; triumphant and victorious is he, humble and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.
text_cn: 熙雍女子，你应尽量喜乐！耶路撒冷女子，你应该欢呼！看，你的君王到你这里来，他是正义的，胜利的，谦逊的，骑在驴上，骑在驴驹上。

text_en: He will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the war-horse from Jerusalem; and the battle bow shall be cut off, and he shall command peace to the nations; his dominion shall be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
text_cn: 他要由厄弗辣因铲除战车，从耶路撒冷除掉战马，作战的弓箭也要被消除；他要向万民宣布和平，他的权柄由这海到那海，从大河直达地极。

text_en: As for you also, because of the blood of my covenant with you, I will set your prisoners free from the waterless pit.
text_cn: 你，熙雍女子！因了你盟约的血，我要从无水地牢中释放你的俘虏。

text_en: Return to your stronghold, O prisoners of hope; today I declare that I will restore to you double.
text_cn: 怀着希望的俘虏，必要回到你这里。熙雍女子！我必双倍偿还你在充军之日所遭受的一切，

text_en: For I have bent Judah as my bow; I have made Ephraim its arrow. I will arouse your sons, O Zion, against your sons, O Greece, and wield you like a warrior’s sword.
text_cn: 因为我要以犹大作我张开的弓，以厄弗辣因作我弓上的箭。熙雍！我要鼓动你的子民，使你有如勇士的剑，为攻击雅汪子民。

text_en: Then the Lord will appear over them, and his arrow go forth like lightning; the Lord God will sound the trumpet and march forth in the whirlwinds of the south.
text_cn: 上主必要在他们上面出现，像闪电一般射出他的箭；吾主上主必要吹起号角，乘着南方的旋风前来。

text_en: The Lord of hosts will protect them, and they shall devour and tread down the slingers; they shall drink their blood like wine, and be full like a bowl, drenched like the corners of the altar.
text_cn: 万军的上主必保卫他们，使他们前进，践踏投石的人；他们必要喝他们的血，有如喝酒；饱享鲜血，有如祭坛的四角。

text_en: On that day the Lord their God will save them for they are the flock of his people; for like the jewels of a crown they shall shine on his land.
text_cn: 到那一天，上主他们的天主，必要拯救他们，要牧放他的百姓，有如牧放羊群；他们将如王冠上的宝石，在他的地上闪烁。

text_en: For what goodness and beauty are his! Grain shall make the young men flourish, and new wine the young women.
text_cn: 那时，此地是多么幸福，多么美丽！五谷滋养少男，新酒培育处女。
